text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During training with Gold City. Eager to 
produce quick results and make everyone 
acknowledge her, she found herself growing 
impatient.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, she encounters Tamamo Cross, 
who tells Gold City that she really likes 
her raw, burning fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross revealed that she was running 
to give her family an easier life. 
However, she had yet to produce results 
worthy of recognition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make the world acknowledge their 
running—sharing the same conviction, the 
two promised that they would face each 
other in a race someday.
